job.question: A sample investment management RFP for a domestic equity small cap growth mandate sets portfolio guidelines. What are the limits on single-issuer holdings, foreign issuers and cash, and which index must the portfolio outperform?
job.expected_facts: No more than 5% of the portfolio (at time of purchase) in any single issuer other than the Federal Government/Agencies or the designated cash reserve fund; no more than 20% in foreign issuers, which must trade on the NYSE, ASE or NASDAQ; cash and equivalents no more than 10% except during cash withdrawals or contributions; the portfolio is expected to outperform the Russell 2000 Growth Index, net of fees. Issuer: Illinois Municipal Retirement Fund (IMRF) sample RFP.
job.acceptance: Accept equivalent 5% single-issuer at purchase, 20% foreign listed on specified US exchanges, 10% cash, and Russell 2000 Growth net-of-fee target. Preserve material exceptions; issuer identification is optional.

reviews.reason: This is an Anchorage Police and Fire Retirement System RFP for investment consulting services, not the IMRF sample RFP for a domestic small-cap growth mandate. Its superficially similar percentages apply to different or materially different rules; it does not support the specified foreign-issuer, cash, or benchmark requirements.
quotes: This Request for Proposal (RFP) is issued by the Anchorage Police and Fire Retirement System.
The Board of Trustees of the Anchorage Police and Fire Retirement System intends to secure a contract for investment consultant services.
No individual security of the portfolio shall constitute more than the greater of 5% or the security’s weight in the agreed upon market index plus 2%.
Listed American Depository Receipts (ADR’s) shall be an approved investment, and shall constitute no more than 20% of the market value of the assets controlled by a manager.
